errors.text_span: der längste ist "Indien" mit einem Wert von 41,1
errors.evidence: The longest bar in the chart corresponds to "Irland" with a value of 67.7, not "Indien" which has a value of 41.1.

errors.text_span: Die Länder "Kroatien", "China", "Polen" und "Indien" werden durch blaue Balken dargestellt, während der Rest der Länder durch andere Farbtöne dargestellt wird.
errors.evidence: This misrepresents the colors. All bars are light blue except for the bar for "Deutschland", which is purple. The description incorrectly suggests only four countries have blue bars and the others have various other shades.

errors.text_span: Die Balken sind absteigend nach dem jeweiligen Wert sortiert.
errors.evidence: The bars are not sorted in a single descending order. The chart is split into two groups. The top group (negative values) is sorted in ascending order by value (from -16.3 to -9.4). The bottom group (positive values) is also sorted in ascending order (from 23.3 to 67.7).
The description fails to mention that the bar for "Deutschland" is visually highlighted with a distinct purple color, which is a salient feature of the chart.

The description does not mention the fundamental structure of the chart, which is a tornado/butterfly chart separating countries with negative values from those with positive values. The caption even refers to these as "Gewinner" (winners) and "Verlierer" (losers).

errors.text_span: Der kürzeste Balken ist "Vereinigtes Königreich" mit einem Wert von -16,3
errors.evidence: The term "kürzeste" (shortest) is ambiguous. The bar for "Vereinigtes Königreich" represents the most negative value (-16.3) and is visually the longest bar on the negative side of the axis. The shortest bar on the negative side is "USA" (-9.4).
